title: esenbeckia pumila var. leucophylla
intro: Esenbeckia pumila var. leucophylla, commonly known as Puna, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family, native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as prevent the growth of bacteria and fungi. The therapeutic actions of Puna include acting as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Puna include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and provide potential health benefits when used appropriately.
